summary: Mistral released version 1.11.3 of the mistral-common library with small bug fixes and compatibility changes for OpenAI format conversion and tokenizer handling.

practices.reason: Minor library fixes to OpenAI request/response conversion and tokenizer error messaging could affect teams using mistral-common but require no urgent migration.
practices.quote: Fix: forward continue_final_message in tekken normalizers (V7/V15) by @matdou
